identity.title: Sway shared-memory preview
identity.summary: Temporary trusted shared-memory desktop. Upstream Sway with its native workspace bar and readable Foot terminals. Alt (Option on Mac) + 1–0 switches workspaces; Shift moves a window. Alt+Return opens a terminal; Alt+M, release Alt, then Q asks to exit. The Desktop command mode also controls layout, fullscreen and resize.

guide.title: Sway shared-memory preview
guide.summary: Temporary preview for mutually trusted compatible programs. Files are lost when this machine closes. From Foot, try freeciv, scummvm or scummvm-play god-of-thunder. Alt is Option on Mac. Use Alt+Return for a terminal; Alt+1–0 for workspaces; Alt+Shift+1–0 to move windows; Alt+H/J/K/L to focus. Click the native bar to switch workspaces. Alt+M enters Desktop commands: release Alt, then Return opens a terminal, W/S/E changes layout, F toggles fullscreen, V toggles floating, Space changes focus mode, R resizes with H/J/K/L, C reloads and Q asks to exit. Escape leaves a command/resize mode. Applications run from the terminal. Some browser and OS shortcuts remain reserved. Use an ordinary custom Sway config for advanced bindings.

identity.title: Sway with SFWBar shared-memory preview
identity.summary: Temporary trusted shared-memory desktop. An explicit Sway preset with SFWBar Start, task list and clock. The compositor uses the same Alt/Option desktop bindings as plain Sway; this preset keeps the GTK panel separate from the native Swaybar demo.

guide.title: Sway with SFWBar shared-memory preview
guide.summary: Temporary preview for mutually trusted compatible programs. Files are lost when this machine closes. From Foot, try freeciv, scummvm or scummvm-play god-of-thunder. Alt is Option on Mac. Use Alt+Return for a terminal; Alt+1–0 for workspaces; Alt+Shift+1–0 to move windows; Alt+H/J/K/L to focus. Use the real SFWBar Start, task list and pager controls. Alt+M enters Desktop commands: release Alt, then Return opens a terminal, W/S/E changes layout, F toggles fullscreen, V toggles floating, Space changes focus mode, R resizes with H/J/K/L, C reloads and Q asks to exit. Escape leaves a command/resize mode. Launch applications from Start or the terminal. Some browser and OS shortcuts remain reserved. Use an ordinary custom Sway config for advanced bindings.
